facts.material: electrical/electrochemical cartridge (assumed to hold electrodes, plastic housing)
facts.function: generates chlorine from salt in spa water and dispenses it

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8543 covers electrical machines and apparatus having individual functions; 8543.30 covers electrolysis apparatus

rejected_alternatives.reason: water filtering or purifying machinery; a chlorine generator is an electrolytic device rather than a filter (N327541 concerned a UV and ozone sanitizer)
parts line; used if the cartridge is only a component of a larger chlorinator unit
chlorine as a chemical; the cartridge is a device generating it, not chlorine itself
dispenser/thermometer type (N345952); not a measuring instrument

missing_facts: Whether the cartridge contains electrodes and is powered (electrolytic) or holds a chemical (would change to chapter 28/38 or 8421.99)
Whether it is imported separately from the control unit
classification.rationale: A salt-system cartridge that produces chlorine in spa water is taken to be an electrolysis cell, so heading 8543 and subheading 8543.30 apply. F89627 placed components of industrial chlorine electrolysis machines in 8543.90, showing the heading family; it is cited only as context because it concerns parts of industrial machines.
